senses.sense_definition: A soft, silvery-white alkali metal, the lightest solid chemical element, with atomic number 3.

examples.text: The demand for <w>lithium</w> has increased significantly due to the rise of electric vehicles.
Pure <w>lithium</w> is highly reactive and must be stored in oil to avoid reacting with air.

senses.sense_definition: Lithium carbonate or another lithium salt used as a medication to treat bipolar disorder and stabilize mood.

examples.text: The doctor prescribed <w>lithium</w> to help manage the severe mood swings caused by bipolar disorder.
Patients taking <w>lithium</w> require regular blood tests to monitor levels in their system.

senses.sense_definition: A battery that uses lithium or lithium compounds, especially a rechargeable lithium-ion battery.

examples.text: Make sure your camera uses rechargeable <w>lithium</w> cells instead of standard alkaline batteries.
This portable speaker runs on a powerful internal <w>lithium</w> that lasts up to ten hours.

traits.comment: short for lithium battery or lithium cell

examples.text: Each neutral <w>lithium</w> possesses three protons, four neutrons, and three orbiting electrons.
The laser was tuned to excite an isolated <w>lithium</w> trapped inside the magnetic field.

senses.sense_definition: An unincorporated community and inactive village in Perry County, Missouri, United States.

examples.text: They drove past the quiet village of <w>Lithium</w> while exploring rural Perry County.
The small settlement of <w>Lithium</w> was originally named after the mineral springs nearby.
